description: A tight-binding chain of N atoms: the N levels it produces, the bandwidth, and the spacing between levels. Shows where a band COMES FROM — with 2 atoms the level splits in two (alpha +/- beta), and with many the spacing falls as 1/N until it drops below k_B*T, which is when talking about individual levels stops making sense.

alpha.description: Energy of the isolated atomic orbital (eV)

name: band_formation
